Title text 'python → typescript: port against port'

Subtitle text 'Each cell is one pair: the port on its row read against the port on its column. Lower triangle prints the value, upper fills it as colour. The diagonal is left out, a port against itself being 100. Colour runs over the measured range, 1% to 87%. Strips on both headers carry the condition; the hand-written reference takes the last row and column.'
